A few things to know.

Can I keep my existing numbers and IVR?

Yes. Bring your business number and use existing IVR recordings for analysis.

Which channels and languages are supported?

Phone and WhatsApp calls, plus SMS and WhatsApp messages. The suite supports Hindi, English, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam.

Can the AI hand a caller to my team?

Yes. Route to a specialist AI or a person. Ring available agents in round robin, serial, or parallel order, or bring several agents into a group call.

How can I try it?

Call +91 80 6559 0741, choose a language, and ask to speak to a person. You can also book a connected product demo.

structuredData.name: RoboRingo
structuredData.description: AI-native communications platform for calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM — with AI agents that handle every conversation 24/7.

mainEntity.name: Can the AI agent transfer calls to my human team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our AI agents can seamlessly route and transfer calls to specific departments or human agents based on caller intent or complexity. When a call is transferred, the human agent receives a real-time transcript and summary of the interaction so far.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to buy separate phone numbers for RoboRingo?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. RoboRingo is a complete communications platform. We provide local, toll-free, and mobile numbers in over 180 countries. However, if you already have business numbers, you can easily port them to our platform.

mainEntity.name: Can the AI agent integrate with my existing CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Through our native integrations and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), RoboRingo natively syncs with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, and Zendesk. The AI agent can look up customer records in real-time and log interaction summaries automatically.

mainEntity.name: How fast does the AI agent respond during a live call?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our voice models are optimized for ultra-low latency, typically responding in under 3 seconds. The agents also feature advanced interruption handling, meaning if a caller interrupts, the AI stops speaking and listens, just like a human.
Yes, our platform supports over 50 languages natively across both voice calls and text-based channels (SMS/WhatsApp). The AI agent can automatically detect the caller's language and respond fluently.
